messages:
viv: Quick PR incoming to tidy the Quickstart "hello" page. Replacing the curl example with a short SDK snippet, normalizing env var names, and fixing a broken anchor. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4242

reid: paste the node snippet here? want to verify the auth shape matches SDK docs.

viv: short snippet below:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', input: 'Hi' });
console.log(resp.text || resp.output);
```

nina: 👍 looks good. please also update the docker run example to use REDWOOD_API_KEY (users copy-paste that).

viv: done  swapped `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere, updated the container tag to `redwood/hello:stable`, and added a two-line migration note pointing to /sdk/migrate for SDK3→SDK4 (ctor vs setApiKey).

reid: small nit: prefer `input` key in examples across the docs. i'll push a one-line tweak if that's ok.

viv: yes please. i'll wait for your review before merging.

docs-bot: ci:docs  linkcheck + lint queued for PR #4242.
